scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and finite independent moment regression are supplied; numerical examples are not an infinite-domain proof. No claim of independent certification, authorship attribution beyond cited prior papers, or complete literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: No general classification of collinear-center convex bodies; no higher-dimensional result; the quantitative angle bound has no asserted global sharpness. General centroid Steiner formula and curvature-centroid definition are prior knowledge. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Hyperbolic curvature paths and quantitative triangle rigidity
